description: The graph illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 score (%) for two different tokenization methods: "MATTER (ours)" and "w/o material information." The x-axis represents the number of tokens, ranging from 0.6 to 1.5, while the y-axis shows the Macro-F1 score, ranging from 48% to 58%. The "MATTER (ours)" method is represented by a pink line with circular markers, and the "w/o material information" method is represented by a purple line with circular markers. The "MATTER (ours)" method generally achieves higher Macro-F1 scores compared to the "w/o material information" method across all token counts. Both lines show a peak around 1.0 tokens, with the "MATTER (ours)" method reaching a score of approximately 57.5% and the "w/o material information" method reaching around 53%. After this peak, both methods show a decline in performance as the number of tokens increases beyond 1.0. The shaded regions around each line represent the confidence intervals, indicating the variability in the scores.
